name: checkout-web PR #1290 review — show the payment date on the receipt
turns: PR #1290 shows the payment date on the receipt page. My AI assistant suggested moment.js for the formatting, so I added it to package.json.
Please take moment.js out. We removed it from checkout-web in March 2026, it was 67 KB gzipped of the bundle. ADR-0003 says date-fns format() plus Intl.DateTimeFormat for anything locale-aware.
Will do. The receipt also fetches the ledger entry directly from ledger-service to show the fee. Is that fine?
No, the browser never calls ledger-service directly. Go through the checkout-api BFF; it adds auth and the Idempotency-Key header. I will add a /receipts/{id} endpoint there this week.
Thanks. I will switch to date-fns and call the BFF endpoint once it is merged.
pinned: Do not add moment.js to checkout-web: it was removed in March 2026 (67 KB gzipped). Use date-fns format() and Intl.DateTimeFormat instead (ADR-0003).
checkout-web must never call ledger-service from the browser; every payment call goes through the checkout-api BFF, which adds auth and the Idempotency-Key header.
